info.name: EVE Swagger Interface Alliance Killmails API
EVE Online Get a Character's Recent Kills and Losses

params.name: character_id
params.description: An EVE character ID

params.name: datasource
params.description: The server name you would like data from

params.name: page
params.description: Which page of results to return

params.name: token
params.description: Access token to use if unable to set a header

items.docs:
Return a list of a character's kills and losses going back 90 days

---
Alternate route: `/dev/characters/{character_id}/killmails/recent/`

Alternate route: `/legacy/characters/{character_id}/killmails/recent/`

Alternate route: `/v1/characters/{character_id}/killmails/recent/`

---
This route is cached for up to 300 seconds
